player_prompt.intro: Wena ungumdlali {player_id} udlala umdlalo weDames njengo {color}. Yenza isinyathelo sakho ngesitayela se-chess notation [fileRank fileRank], isibonelo '[b2c3]' (umgqa wezinhlamvu ah, umugqa wezinombolo 07). Imithetho eyisisekelo: • Hamba phambili ngokuya phambili ngo-1 uma kungenalutho. • Thatha ngokuxhuma phezu kwesidumbu somphikisi. • Isiqeshana sibizwa ngokuthi yiNkosi uma sifinyelela ekugcineni okuphambene.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ayikho ifomethi yokunyakaza evumelekile etholakele. Sebenzisa [a1b2], isibonelo [b2c3].
